input: root is None or the root of a finite, acyclic binary tree with at most 4294967295 nodes and no shared child nodes. Each caller-owned TreeNode has ordinary data fields val, left and right, without getters, proxies or concurrent mutation; children are nodes or None. Node values are integers, and the sum of their absolute values over the entire tree must be <= 9007199254740991. Integers are plain int values, excluding bool. Containers are ordinary lists rather than subclasses; strings are ordinary str values. Standard built-ins are unmodified and no concurrent mutation occurs. Preconditions are not checked at runtime. Declared size bounds do not guarantee allocation capacity or completion within an unqualified runtime budget.
return: For a nonempty tree, the maximum integer sum of a nonempty simple path of adjacent parent-child nodes. A path may begin/end anywhere, cross through a node using both children, and need not include the root. All-negative trees return the largest single-node value, not zero. The author-defined empty-tree extension returns 0.
mutation_aliasing: No node, value or child field is written. Input identities and all caller aliases remain intact. Private traversal frames borrow node references; the gain stack stores only integers. No node or path is returned, and the Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: The sum-of-absolute-values bound covers every downward gain, node-plus-child partial addition, through-node sum and global best, including cancellation. A final-result-only or root-to-leaf-only bound would not suffice. Each nonnegative child gain uses disjoint subtree nodes, so combining both cannot exceed the absolute-value budget. All arithmetic is exact in the declared paired domain.
complexity: O(n + 1) time and O(h + 1) live auxiliary space for tree height h. Explicit frames perform left, right, node postorder; the completed right gain is popped before the left gain. At most O(h) pending frames and completed sibling gains are retained. O(n) constant-size frame records are allocated over the call, but only O(h) are live simultaneously. No recursion, node-keyed hash table or caller node annotation is used.
